seo.title: Bikram Sambat (Nepali) to AD Date Converter — Private Browser Tool
seo.meta_description: Standalone adapter for the project’s validated Bikram Sambat civil-date dataset, with trust-tier metadata and no fabricated arithmetic approximation.

blocker: The standalone package does not yet contain the existing validated 77,070-day BS↔AD month/day dataset. Reusing that exact local dataset is required; an approximate “+56/57 years” conversion would be misleading.
